# Literary Work

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:LiteraryWork`](gmeow-LiteraryWork.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/LiteraryWork>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/documents`](../../slices/documents.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

An abstract long-form story or textual work — fiction, poetry, drama, or literary non-fiction. A specialization of [`gmeow:Work`](gmeow-Work.md).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Work`](gmeow-Work.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:LiteraryWork`](gmeow-LiteraryWork.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Work`](gmeow-Work.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for an abstract long-form authored story or text — a novel, poetry collection, play, or literary essay at the [`gmeow:Work`](gmeow-Work.md) tier, the out-of-universe creation that sources an in-universe narrative.

### Avoid when

- Avoid conflating it with the in-universe narrative frame it contributes to (that is a narrative-slice construct linked by [`gmeow:sourceFor`](../properties/gmeow-sourceFor.md)) and avoid it for a published edition (a [`gmeow:BookRelease`](gmeow-BookRelease.md) manifestation).

### How to use

- Type the work [`gmeow:LiteraryWork`](gmeow-LiteraryWork.md), give it [`gmeow:hasTitle`](../properties/gmeow-hasTitle.md) and [`gmeow:hasSegment`](../properties/gmeow-hasSegment.md) chapters; link concrete editions as [`gmeow:BookRelease`](gmeow-BookRelease.md) and the narrative frame it sources via [`gmeow:sourceFor`](../properties/gmeow-sourceFor.md).

### Examples

- ex:novel a [`gmeow:LiteraryWork`](gmeow-LiteraryWork.md); [`gmeow:hasTitle`](../properties/gmeow-hasTitle.md) ex:novelTitle; [`gmeow:hasSegment`](../properties/gmeow-hasSegment.md) ex:chapter1.
